label: Sprinter
about: The sprinter: a light, fast, angular mech on long legs with running feet, a wide stance and a long stride; two side cannons and one roof machine gun.
frame: +X left, +Y up, +Z forward; meters (scaled); origin on the ground midway between the hips
placement: item display at the mech origin; matrix = mech * segment(pose) * translate(pivot) * rotate_xyz(rest). aim parts instead sit at their posed pivot with local +Y turned toward their posed links.to point. The pack scales the half-size models back to 1:1.

anims.aim: at its pivot on its segment, local +Y aimed at links.to on links.to_segment (pistons)
anims.spin_z: rigid with its segment, then turned about its own local Z (heavy gun barrels)
anims.hinge_x: rigid with its segment, then turned about its own local X at its pivot (the roof hatch, hinged at its rear edge; negative opens it)

damage_state: custom_model_data string 0 = "damaged" swaps to the _damaged model

parts.label: Pelvis frame (crossbeam and keel)
parts.effect: Cracks: both hips sag and lose torque; at 0 the mech collapses

parts.label: Waist slewing ring and drive motor
parts.effect: Jams with damage: the torso turns slower; at 0 it locks facing where it was

parts.label: Power pack (battery and cables)
parts.effect: Loses charge with HP: every motor weakens; at 0 only the air pistons move the legs

parts.label: Air compressor (feeds both leg tanks)
parts.effect: Stops pumping: the leg tanks run down as the pistons work
